analysis_plan.fold_assignment: source-defined template binding strata, outcome-independent hash ordering
analysis_plan.selection: minimum pooled inner-OOF Brier; ties use first declared l2; refit outer training only

ensemble_method: mean of the fixed seeded OOF probabilities per target, never label-weighted

feature_manifest.confidence_measurement_backend: Transformers BF16 exact saved prompt prefill distributions; no generation
feature_manifest.limitation: Exploratory nested grouped cross-validation on previously consumed discovery data. Scalar next-token confidence is allowed in explicitly labelled B tiers; no mechanism C or unfamiliar-program/final confirmation is claimed. The new Transformers BF16 prefill measurement backend differs from the original vLLM outcome backend. Confidence is next-token sign/format confidence, not complete integer-answer confidence. Its scientific access cost is one target prefill per target, even when cached: no target response, generated token, target correctness or token identity is a feature. Raw neutral tiers separately use one distinct reference query; scored tiers also require reference correctness; source-oracle tiers separately receive the source oracle value. Adding neutral correctness to source-oracle plus raw-neutral features adds an encoding of existing information, not a new observation. Repeated partition seeds reuse the same targets, not independent replications. Template bootstrap intervals condition on saved OOF probabilities without refitting or multiplicity adjustment.
